amendment: E: bounded uncertainty audit and conditional-person quadrature
scope: 3PL/4PL only; retain original certification registry, item estimators, parameter SE/CI gates and every failed A-D record

existing_failures.threePL_MAP: b/c Wald coverage .976/.975, MCSE .0025-.0026; posterior curvature is not sampling covariance of penalized estimator. Existing sandwich/crossprod failures not repeated
existing_failures.fourPL: posterior SE/CI not calibrated; point/IRF/information certification already obtained via D4; no new R timeouts
existing_failures.itemfit: S-X2/df identity supports numerical calculation, not p-value null calibration; production 3PL/4PL p gates remain closed

proposed_correction.method: Existing Python mirt fscores EAP public API, N(0,1) latent scale, fixed calibrated items. GH121 and GH241, no item re-estimation. Publish GH241 only if both EAP and posterior SD agree within absolute 1e-6; otherwise fail closed with numerical-precision reason.
proposed_correction.uncertainty: Conditional posterior SD, not frequentist person SE/CI and not calibration uncertainty. No inference certification from quadrature identity.
proposed_correction.production: Only 3PL/4PL person calls in UI/shared export paths; preserve all other models and parameter inference gates.
proposed_correction.fit_outputs: Keep existing numbers; explicitly label 3PL/4PL MAP logLik/AIC/BIC as evaluated at MAP, not classical ML model-selection evidence.

confirmatory_checks.native: One small deterministic fitting fixture per model, reused fitted parameters for scoring all-zero/all-one/mixed patterns, plus fixed parameter tail diagnostic; no repeated calibration to seek PASS.
confirmatory_checks.reference: Independent scipy.integrate.quad over the real line using fitted coefficients, Gaussian prior and Bernoulli log likelihood. First/second moments centered at mode for stability. abs EAP/SD difference <=1e-6, repeat integration settings to verify reference accuracy. Node-stability is necessary but independent check also required.
gates: valid finite binary responses and IDs preserved
public API IDs/order, finite positive posterior SD
no inference CERTIFIED promotion without independent recovery/coverage evidence
confirmatory_checks.regression: Only affected person/report/policy tests; existing certification records byte-identical. CI asynchronous, no full-suite local run.

new_certification: NONE pre-authorized by these numerical checks. VERIFIED conditional integration does not imply empirical recovery, coverage or calibrated item-fit inference.
not_run: No fresh parameter coverage campaign without sufficient independent replication and before-deadline feasibility. No ad hoc rescaling, transformed-endpoint relabeling, naive profile-chi-square at MAP/boundary, or new R fit.
references: Wilks (1938): regular ML likelihood-ratio theory, not a generic MAP/boundary pivot
White (1982): sandwich covariance and distinction between curvature and sampling variance
Direct Bayes rule: posterior moments conditional on fixed item parameters; these do not integrate item-calibration uncertainty
